name: ghostwriter
description: Keeps AI self-attribution out of the work. PreToolUse hooks inspect every Bash call that authors a git object, every file write, and every GitHub MCP post, blocking co-author trailers, "generated with <tool>" footers, product attribution links, tool-named session trailers, attribution written into source files, committer identities that name an AI tool, and commits made under no identity at all. Opt-in git hooks extend the same rules to commits made outside the session. Bare product mentions are always allowed.
